metadataRaw.title: What Is the Sciatic Nerve and Why Does It Hurt so Much? Answered by St. Joseph, MI Chiropractor
metadataRaw.description:
Anyone who currently suffers (or has ever suffered) from sciatic nerve pain knows what REAL pain feels like. 

Here at SpineCare Decompression and Chiropractic Center in St. Joseph MI, we’re great at treating low back and sciatica pain. 

With thousands of individual sciatica pain treatments given over the years, I can confidently say to you that REAL relief can be experienced, sometimes as early as your very first treatment session.

If you are looking for effective back and neck pain relief, contact us at 269-408-8439 or visit us at https://www.bestspinecare.com
